name: Vertical Warp Slideshow
description: Full-screen vertical image slideshow where slides push past each other with a rotating, stretching warp, staggered text line reveals, an arrow cursor, and an animated counter with progress bar.
contents: Full-screen slides with background image and two-line uppercase caption
Top-left series title and description, top-right hint text
Bottom counter with rolling numbers and progress bar
Custom circular cursor showing previous or next arrow
behavior: Navigates by wheel, click on left or right half, arrow keys, or vertical touch swipe
Outgoing image warps with scale and rotation while the next slides in; caption lines reveal with stagger
Cursor ring follows the mouse, shows a direction arrow and hides after inactivity

props.name: seriesDesc
props.default: Navigate through a visual journey exploring the boundaries between form and emptiness.

editableByProps: Slide images, caption lines and number of slides
Transition duration, cursor timeout, caption tracking and font class
Series title, description, hint text and background color

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the warp angle or scale

needsCodeEdit.where: mix-blend-difference overlay blocks at the bottom of the JSX

fixed: Registers document and window listeners for wheel, click, keys, touch and mouse, removed on unmount
Wheel, click and key input anywhere on the page navigates slides, so use one per page
Overlays and cursor use fixed positioning with white difference-blended text
Renders only after mount, so nothing appears during server render
